text.content: Not a person, not a single unique monster — a model. Any megacorp with a large enough soul-infrastructure budget can build or lease one: a ghost-machine built for exactly one purpose, dispatched the moment a Binding Clause defaults. It does not negotiate, threaten, or arrest. It arrives, locates the soul-collateral written into the broken contract at signing, and physically repossesses it — extracting the collateralized fragment whether or not the body it's attached to survives the process. Corporate legal departments describe this, without irony, as "standard collections procedure." Free Havens consider a Foreclosure Engine sighting a settlement-wide emergency; nobody wants one that close deciding it has a second name on file.
